decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The Authority refuses to grant approval for the following reason:
The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an inappropriate and obtrusive feature in the locality, the effect of which would unduly impact on the visual and residential amenity in the area including the Metropolitan Open Land.   The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies ENV 1.1, ENV 4.7, ENV 5.1 and ENV 1.12 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan; Policies ENVB 1.1, ENVB 1.7.  ENVN 1.5 and ENVN 2.1 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8, (Telecommunications).  The application is therefore refused permission due to siting and appearance.
description: Erection of 12m high column to simulate telegraph pole and 2 equipment cabins to site
